name: Homepage
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Homepage is a start page for your services and bookmarks, with widgets for many self-hosted apps. The egg builds it on the first start and serves it behind a password you set; edit the files in the config folder to build your page.
startup: v=$(cat source/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null); b="$v $(node --version)"; if [ "$b" != "$(cat app/.raptor-built 2>/dev/null)" ]; then [ -f source/package.json ] || { echo "Reinstall the server to download Homepage."; exit 1; }; echo "Building Homepage $v for Node.js $(node --version). This takes a few minutes, once."; (cd source && export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 CI=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_VERSION="$v" npm_config_store_dir=/home/container/source/.pnpm-store && corepack pnpm@10 install --frozen-lockfile --reporter=append-only && corepack pnpm@10 run build) || { echo "Homepage's build failed: see the errors above."; exit 1; }; rm -rf app.new && cp -a source/.next/standalone app.new && cp -a source/public app.new/public && cp -a source/.next/static app.new/.next/static && echo "$b" > app.new/.raptor-built && rm -rf app && mv app.new app && rm -rf source/node_modules source/.next source/.pnpm-store && echo "Built Homepage $v." || exit 1; fi; if [ -z "${HOMEPAGE_AUTH_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "Set Login password in the server's settings, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; url="${HOMEPAGE_EXTERNAL_URL:-}"; [ -n "$url" ] || url="http://${SERVER_IP:-127.0.0.1}:{{SERVER_PORT}}"; host=${url#*://}; host=${host%%/*}; export HOMEPAGE_EXTERNAL_URL="$url" HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS="$host,localhost:{{SERVER_PORT}},127.0.0.1:{{SERVER_PORT}}${ALLOWED_HOSTS:+,$ALLOWED_HOSTS}" HOMEPAGE_AUTH_ENABLED=true HOMEPAGE_AUTH_SECRET="$(cat .auth-secret)" HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR=/home/container/config LOG_TARGETS=stdout NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 PORT={{SERVER_PORT}}; cd app && exec node server.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Homepage: downloads the source of the chosen Homepage release from GitHub
# into the source folder; the server builds it at its next start, for the
# Node.js version it runs (Homepage publishes no ready-made build). The
# config folder (your services, bookmarks, widgets) is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag gethomepage/homepage "$version") ||
    fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.8.0, then reinstall."
major=${tag#v}; major=${major%%.*}
# Homepage has its own login from 2.0 on, which this egg turns on.
[ "$major" -ge 2 ] || fail "This egg runs Homepage 2.0 and newer. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.8.0, then reinstall."

if [ -f source/package.json ] && [ "$(cat source/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Homepage $tag is already downloaded."
else
    echo "Downloading Homepage $tag."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$work/homepage.tar.gz" "https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage/archive/refs/tags/$tag.tar.gz" ||
        fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir "$work/source"
    tar -xzf "$work/homepage.tar.gz" -C "$work/source" --strip-components=1
    [ -f "$work/source/pnpm-lock.yaml" ] || fail "Homepage $tag has no pnpm-lock.yaml, so this egg can't build it. Set Version to latest, then reinstall."
    echo "$tag" > "$work/source/.raptor-version"
    rm -rf source
    mv "$work/source" source
fi

mkdir -p config
# The key Homepage signs its login cookies with.
[ -s .auth-secret ] || head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 > .auth-secret
echo "Installed Homepage $tag. It is built when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Homepage version to install, such as 2.8.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it, and the next start builds it.

variables.name: Login password
variables.description: The password to sign in to Homepage with, at least 12 characters.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The full address you open Homepage at, with http or https in front. Empty uses the server's address and port.

variables.name: Allowed hosts
variables.description: Other host names Homepage answers to, with their port where it isn't 80 or 443, separated by commas.
